info.title: HoopsLab API
info.description: Cross-league basketball translation. Every served number comes from a fitted model or a measured column and carries the version that produced it. Paths marked pending are waiting on data this project does not yet have; paths marked withdrawn measured something no public data supports, and say so instead of returning a plausible number.

data_snapshot.description: The snapshot this deployment serves. Every cache key is prefixed with it.

leagues.description: Which leagues this person appears in, e.g. "EL+NBA".

snapshot.description: The data snapshot every number in this response came from. Also prefixes the cache key, so a stale response identifies itself.

resolved.description: Present when a season was resolved rather than matched. `exact` or `latest_available` — never a silent substitution.

model.description: The model that produced these numbers, with its headline error, so a value never appears without the accuracy of the thing that made it.

page.description: How many rows matched against how many were returned. Without this a truncated ranking and a complete one are indistinguishable.

type.description: Link to this code's entry in docs/errors.md.

seasonOrder.description: Integer sort key. Season ids do not sort correctly across leagues.

qualified.description: Whether the season clears the minutes floor to count as a measurement.

matchMethod.description: How the link was made: anchor, shared_nba_person_id, name_and_age, ...

confidence.description: Below 0.8 the link is reported but excluded from the modelling cohort.

fold.description: "overall" for the pooled row, otherwise the season.

shuffledMae.description: The shuffled-target control, which a model with no signal matches.

beatsBestBaseline.description: Whether the model beats the best baseline for this metric. Served rather than logged, so a metric it loses on says so.

skillVsBest.description: Fractional error reduction against the best baseline; negative is worse.

actualValue.description: What actually happened, where the move is already in the past.

stabilityJaccard.description: Bootstrap stability. Clusters are not equally real, so it is served, not hidden.

distance.description: Euclidean in the whitened archetype space, which is the correct metric here.

shrinkageWeight.description: How much of the number is the player's own attempts rather than the league prior. A 40-attempt shooter is mostly prior, and that is the difference between a measurement and an impression.

report.description: The structured `ScoutingReport`: claims, the fact ids behind them, confidence.

evidence.description: The evidence bundle the report was written from, rendered as text.

inSupport.description: False means the player's standing sits outside the range where transferring players were observed, so the interval understates the uncertainty.

supportNMovers.description: Observed transfers behind this direction's intercept.

get.summary: Every endpoint and its state.
get.description: Generated from the endpoint registry, which is also what mounts the withdrawn handlers and what the OpenAPI document is checked against.

200.description: The full surface, including what is pending and what is gone.

get.summary: Liveness, and real D1 and KV reachability.
get.description: Probes both dependencies rather than reporting on the Worker alone, and answers 503 when either is unreachable. Also reports the data snapshot, which is what makes a stale cached response identifiable.

503.description: D1 or KV is unreachable. The body names which and why.

get.summary: Diacritic-insensitive search over every resolved person.
get.description: Matches against a column Python already de-accented, so `jokic` finds `Jokić`. Cross-league players rank first: they are the ones this project is about.

schema.description: 1-50, default 20. Outside that range the request is rejected.

parameters.description: 1-50, default 20. Outside that range the request is rejected.
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Matching people, cross-league first, then alphabetical.

422.description: INVALID_QUERY: `q` is empty or over 80 characters, or `limit` is not 1-50.

get.summary: A person's whole career across every league they appear in.
get.description: Seasons are ordered by the integer sort key rather than the season id, which would put NBA_2020 above EL_2021. Identity links carry the method and confidence that produced them.

200.description: The person, their seasons in chronological order, and their identity links.

404.description: PERSON_NOT_FOUND: the id does not resolve. Ids are not guessable.

get.summary: Cross-league translation predictions for one person.
get.description: Every row carries its 80% and 95% intervals, and `meta.model` carries the measured error of the model that produced them, so a value never appears without the accuracy of the thing that made it.

200.description: Predictions in source-season order, with the model's own error attached.

404.description: NO_TRANSITION_FOR_PLAYER: the person exists but never changed league, which is the common case. /projections serves the counterfactual instead.

get.summary: Every model version this deployment can serve.
get.description: Each row carries the run that produced it and its headline error, so a prediction elsewhere in the API can always be looked up here.

200.description: The registry, most recently trained first.

get.summary: One model's held-out error against all four baselines.
get.description: Includes the metric the model loses on and the selection gaps that condition every number here, because an evaluation that reports only the wins is not an evaluation.

200.description: The registry row, its per-fold evaluation, and the selection summaries.

404.description: MODEL_VERSION_NOT_FOUND: the version is not in the registry.

get.summary: Players ranked by projected translated production.
get.description: Every row carries its 80% interval and, where the move has already happened, what the player actually did.

schema.description: 1-100, default 25. Outside that range the request is rejected.

parameters.description: 1-100, default 25. Outside that range the request is rejected.
parameters.name: limit

200.description: The ranking for that direction and metric.

404.description: NO_PREDICTIONS_FOR_FILTER: no fitted predictions for that direction and metric.

422.description: INVALID_QUERY: `limit` is not an integer in 1-100.

get.summary: The clusters, their distinguishing features, exemplars and stability.
get.description: Ordered by stability, most reproducible first. A cluster below the floor is flagged in the row and again in `meta.warnings`.

200.description: Every cluster in the archetype model.

get.summary: Archetype assignment per season, carrying that cluster's stability.
get.description: Descriptive, never predictive. Only seasons clearing the 500-minute floor are clustered, so a low-minute season has no assignment rather than one fitted on noise.

200.description: One row per clustered season, in season order.

404.description: NO_ARCHETYPE_FOR_PLAYER: no season clears the minutes floor the model requires.

get.summary: Nearest neighbours in the whitened archetype space.
get.description: Precomputed in Python, because the Worker gets 10 ms of CPU per request. The distance metric is stated on every row rather than left for the reader to assume.

schema.description: Restrict to one season. Omitted, every clustered season is returned.

parameters.description: Restrict to one season. Omitted, every clustered season is returned.
parameters.name: season

200.description: Neighbours ordered by season, then by rank.

404.description: NO_COMPS_FOR_PLAYER: the player has no archetype assignment, so there is no space to find neighbours in.

get.summary: Empirical-Bayes shrunk three-point threat, with the shrinkage weight exposed.
get.description: What replaces the withdrawn gravity metric, named for what it actually measures. Seasons below the attempt floor are served but flagged, because their value is largely the league prior.

200.description: One row per season, in season order.

404.description: NO_SHOOTING_FOR_PLAYER: no season above the three-point attempt floor, below which the estimate would be almost entirely prior.

get.summary: Spacing leaderboard, restricted to players above the attempt floor.
get.description: Ranking on a mostly-prior number would put the smallest samples on top, which is the exact failure shrinkage exists to prevent, so players below the floor are excluded rather than ranked.

schema.description: 1-100, default 25. Outside that range the request is rejected.

parameters.description: 1-100, default 25. Outside that range the request is rejected.
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Players above the attempt floor, ranked by spacing score.

404.description: NO_SHOOTING_FOR_SEASON: the season carries no player above the attempt floor, or is not in the snapshot.

422.description: INVALID_QUERY: `limit` is not an integer in 1-100.

get.summary: A grounded scouting report, served with its groundedness audit.
get.description: Reports are written offline against a fixed evidence bundle and committed with their audit, so a player without one has no report rather than a generated-on-demand one.

schema.description: `true` selects the run where the model was told the subject's name. Anything else selects the anonymized run, which is the default.

parameters.description: `true` selects the run where the model was told the subject's name. Anything else selects the anonymized run, which is the default.
parameters.name: named

200.description: The most recent report for this player, with its audit.

404.description: NO_REPORT_FOR_PLAYER: no report has been generated for this player and season.

get.summary: Projected production for players who have NOT changed league.
get.description: The counterfactual the model exists to answer. Ranked by projection, which puts the least trustworthy rows first, so every row carries an out-of-support flag and `meta.page` says how much of the pool this page is.

schema.description: One of EL->NBA, GL->NBA, NBA->EL, NBA->GL, GL->EL, EL->GL. Defaults to EL->NBA.

parameters.description: One of EL->NBA, GL->NBA, NBA->EL, NBA->GL, GL->EL, EL->GL. Defaults to EL->NBA.
parameters.name: direction

schema.description: Season order floor, 2000-2100. A projection off a 2012 line is a curiosity.

parameters.description: Season order floor, 2000-2100. A projection off a 2012 line is a curiosity.
parameters.name: sinceSeason

schema.description: `true` drops rows the model is extrapolating for. Off by default: those rows top the ranking, so hiding them is something a caller asks for.

parameters.description: `true` drops rows the model is extrapolating for. Off by default: those rows top the ranking, so hiding them is something a caller asks for.
parameters.name: inSupportOnly

schema.description: Row offset into the ranking, default 0.

parameters.description: Row offset into the ranking, default 0.
parameters.name: offset

200.description: A page of the ranking, with the matched total in `meta.page`.

404.description: NO_PROJECTIONS: no player satisfies the direction, season and support filters together.

422.description: INVALID_QUERY: a parameter is malformed or outside its range. `directions` lists the ones that exist.

get.summary: Permanently withdrawn — the underlying quantity is not computable from public data.
get.description:
'Gravity' measures how much defensive attention a player draws, which requires optical player-tracking data. The NBA does not publish it and the EuroLeague does not collect it. The previous version of this endpoint reported gravity values that were typed by hand.

Instead: /players/{personId}/shooting serves an empirical-Bayes shrunk 3PT threat measure, which is computable from public data and is named for what it actually measures.

410.description: METRIC_WITHDRAWN: gone rather than 501, because the data to support this does not exist publicly. It is not on the roadmap.

get.summary: Permanently withdrawn — the underlying quantity is not computable from public data.
get.description:
The 'clutch_impact' figure behind this leaderboard was a hand-written constant on an undefined scale. Clutch impact estimated from the small per-player samples available would be almost entirely noise, and publishing a ranking of noise is worse than publishing nothing.

Instead: Per-game box scores via /games/{gameId}, from which any clutch definition can be computed with its own sample size attached.

410.description: METRIC_WITHDRAWN: gone rather than 501, because the data to support this does not exist publicly. It is not on the roadmap.

get.description:
'swing_index' and the other momentum figures were hand-written constants. Reconstructing genuine run and momentum statistics needs play-by-play data that this project does not yet ingest.

Instead: Play-by-play ingestion is a stretch goal. Until it lands there is no honest momentum number to serve.
